events.title: Reflections of the Soul: A Solo Exhibition by [Artist Name]
events.description: An intimate solo exhibition featuring the works of a prominent Botswana artist, exploring themes of identity, memory, and the human experience through a vibrant collection of paintings and mixed-media pieces. The artist will be present for the opening night to offer guided tours and discuss their creative process.

events.title: Voices of the Kalahari: A Group Exhibition on Desert Life
events.description: A powerful group exhibition bringing together multiple artists to explore the landscapes, cultures, and stories of the Kalahari Desert. Featuring paintings, photography, and sculptures that capture the resilience of the San people, the beauty of the red dunes, and the spirit of Botswana's most iconic wilderness.

events.title: Artists in Botswana 2026: Celebrating Creative Excellence
events.description: The museum's flagship annual event showcasing the breadth of Botswana's artistic community. This exhibition features works from both established and emerging artists across various mediums, including painting, sculpture, photography, and mixed media.

events.title: Indigenous Visions: Art by Botswana's San Women
events.description: An extraordinary exhibition featuring works by indigenous San women artists from the Kuru Art Project. This collection showcases vibrant paintings, prints, and crafts that tell stories of traditional life, the natural world, and the enduring spirit of the Kalahari's first peoples.

events.title: Metal & Memory: Sculptural Explorations of Botswana
events.description: A dedicated exhibition showcasing three-dimensional art forms, including sculptures, installations, and mixed media works. Inspired by artists like Totang Motoloki who transform discarded metal into powerful art, this exhibition invites viewers to reconsider what we value and what we throw away.

events.title: Botswana Through the Lens: A Photographic Journey
events.description: A dedicated showcase of photographic art by local and international photographers capturing the beauty, people, and wildlife of Botswana. From sweeping landscapes to intimate portraits, this exhibition highlights the power of photography to tell Botswana's stories.

events.title: Hands of Our Ancestors: A Celebration of Botswana Craft
events.description: An exhibition featuring traditional crafts, historical artefacts, and cultural heritage items from across Botswana. Highlights include intricate basket weaving, beadwork, pottery, and textiles. This exhibition serves as a testament to the skill and creativity of Botswana's artisans throughout the ages.

events.title: New Narratives: The Revamped Botswana National Museum
events.description: A special event to launch the newly refurbished permanent exhibitions, featuring multimedia displays on environmental, historical, and socio-economic issues. The revamp includes the addition of Sir Seretse Khama and Sir Ketumile Masire's vintage official Daimler Limousines to the national collection.

events.title: Words of Botswana: A Two-Day Creative Writing Seminar
events.description: A two-day seminar organised in partnership with the Botswana Library Association, the National Book Development Council, and the Writers Association of Botswana. Participants will explore storytelling techniques, character development, and the art of writing about Botswana's rich cultural heritage. All are welcome.

events.title: Weaving Our Heritage: Traditional Craft Workshops
events.description: Hands-on workshops teaching traditional skills such as basket weaving, beadwork, pottery, and textile making. Led by master artisans from communities across Botswana, these workshops offer a rare opportunity to learn techniques passed down through generations.
events.date_range: First Saturday of each month starting 6 June 2026

events.title: Discover Your Creative Voice: Art Workshops for Adults
events.description: Workshops on painting, drawing, sculpture, and mixed media techniques led by professional artists. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced artist, these sessions offer a supportive environment to explore your creativity and develop new skills.

events.title: Creative Kids at the Museum: School Holiday Art Programme
events.description: Art and craft activities for children during school breaks, designed to be both educational and fun. Young participants will explore painting, sculpture, storytelling, and traditional crafts while learning about Botswana's cultural heritage.

events.title: Museum After Dark: Open Mic Night
events.description: Regular open mic events for poets, musicians, and storytellers, held in the museum's galleries or outdoor spaces. These evenings provide a platform for emerging and established artists to share their work with a supportive audience.
events.date_range: Last Friday of each month starting 25 June 2026

events.title: Foundations of a Nation: A Lecture Series on Botswana's History
events.description: A monthly lecture series featuring talks by historians, anthropologists, and scholars on topics such as the Tswana kingdoms, the colonial period, the independence movement, and the legacy of Botswana's founding presidents.
events.date_range: First Thursday of each month starting 3 September 2026

events.title: In the Artist's Studio: Talks & Demonstrations
events.description: Artists discuss their work and demonstrate their techniques in this intimate series. Connecting emerging artists with established professionals, these sessions offer unique insights into the creative process and the stories behind the art.
events.date_range: Second Saturday of each month starting 12 September 2026

events.title: Tales from the Firelight: Traditional Storytelling Sessions
events.description: Traditional Setswana folklore and oral history sessions suitable for all ages. Master storytellers share ancient tales of the Tswana people, passing on wisdom, values, and cultural knowledge through the timeless art of storytelling.
events.date_range: Third Friday of each month starting 17 July 2026

events.title: Preserving Botswana's Heritage: An Interdisciplinary Symposium
events.description: An academic symposium for scholars of anthropology, history, and art, focusing on the preservation of Botswana's cultural and natural heritage. The museum has previously hosted symposia on topics such as the Okavango Delta.

events.title: Ask the Experts: Identification Service Clinics
events.description: Public events where the museum offers identification services for small animals, plant species, rocks, and minerals. Bring your finds from nature and learn from the museum's experts about Botswana's rich biodiversity.
events.date_range: Second Saturday of each month starting 8 August 2026

events.title: Museum on the Move: Launch of the Mobile Museum Programme
events.description: An event to launch or promote the museum's mobile museum programme, known as the 'Zebra on wheels', which takes museum exhibits to remote parts of Botswana. The launch will feature a procession, demonstrations, and information about how communities can book the mobile museum.

events.title: International Museum Day 2026: Museums as Cultural Hubs
events.description: An annual global event (18 May) dedicated to promoting museums. The museum will host exhibitions, interactive activities, traditional crafts displays, and digital presentations of heritage sites. This year's theme celebrates the role of museums as cultural hubs that bring communities together.

events.title: 50 Years of Botswana: An Independence Day Exhibition
events.description: A special exhibition marking Botswana's independence (30 September), featuring historic photographs, documents, and artefacts. This exhibition celebrates the journey from the Bechuanaland Protectorate to the Republic of Botswana and honours the leaders who shaped the nation.

events.title: The Father of the Nation: Commemorating Sir Seretse Khama
events.description: An exhibition and events honouring Botswana's first President (1 July), showcasing his life, legacy, and contribution to nation-building. The event will feature the newly acquired Sir Seretse Khama Daimler Limousine, historical photographs, and talks by historians.

events.title: Celebrating 58 Years: Botswana National Museum Anniversary
events.description: Events marking the museum's founding anniversary (1968), including procession floats, Dikgafela performances, exhibition launches, and magazine releases. The museum was established in 1968 and has been a cornerstone of Botswana's cultural life for nearly six decades.

events.title: Celebrating Our Heritage: Botswana Heritage Week
events.description: A week-long programme of activities celebrating Botswana's cultural and natural heritage, including guided tours, workshops, and performances. The programme will highlight the museum's role in preserving the nation's heritage for future generations.

events.title: Rhythms of Botswana: Traditional Music & Dance
events.description: Live performances of traditional Setswana music and dance, showcasing Botswana's performing arts heritage. Featuring groups such as Culture Spears and Matsieng, these performances bring the vibrant rhythms of Botswana to life.
events.date_range: Last Saturday of each month starting 25 July 2026

events.title: A Day in Botswana: Cultural Festival at the Museum
events.description: A one-day festival featuring traditional dance, music, storytelling, crafts, and food. This vibrant event showcases the diversity of Botswana's cultures, with performances, demonstrations, and activities for all ages.

events.title: The Voice of the People: Kgotla Demonstration
events.description: Live demonstrations of a traditional kgotla setup and its role in Tswana society. Visitors will learn how meetings and disputes are settled in the traditional council, experiencing firsthand one of the cornerstones of Botswana's democracy.
events.date_range: Third Saturday of each month starting 19 September 2026

events.title: Pages of Botswana: Book Launch Events
events.description: Launch events for books by Botswana authors and historians, held in the museum's galleries or outdoor spaces. These events celebrate Botswana's literary heritage and provide a platform for new voices.

events.title: Words in the Gallery: Poetry Evenings
events.description: Readings of traditional and contemporary Setswana poetry, often accompanied by music. These evenings bring together poets and poetry lovers to celebrate the power of words in Botswana's cultural life.
events.date_range: Second Thursday of each month starting 10 September 2026

events.title: Botswana on Screen: Documentary Film Screenings
events.description: Documentary screenings on Botswana's history, wildlife, culture, and contemporary issues. The museum has hosted documentary premieres such as 'Tsodilo: The Jewel of the Desert', a collaborative effort between the Metropolitan Museum of Art and the Botswana National Museum.
events.date_range: Fourth Thursday of each month starting 24 September 2026

events.title: Botswana Nationals 2026: Rubik's Cube Championship
events.description: The museum has hosted events like the Botswana Nationals (Rubik's Cube competition). This year's championship brings together competitors from across the country for a day of speed, strategy, and community.

events.title: Music in the Museum: Concert Series
events.description: The museum hosts concerts for a wide range of musical genres. From jazz and classical to traditional Setswana music, these concerts transform the museum into a vibrant cultural venue.

events.title: A Moment in History: Medal Unveiling Ceremony
events.description: High-profile events such as the unveiling of the World Athletics Relays Gaborone 2026 medals. These ceremonies bring together government leaders, creatives, and stakeholders to witness milestones in Botswana's sporting and national history.
events.date_range: To be scheduled for future major sporting events

events.title: A Curated Experience: VIP Tours of the National Museum
events.description: Guided tours for visiting dignitaries, such as the Burundi First Lady's tour of the National Museum. These tours offer a curated experience of Botswana's cultural heritage, including demonstrations of traditional practices such as food preservation and sorghum pounding.

events.title: An Evening of Art: Exhibition Opening Receptions
events.description: Evening receptions to mark the opening of new exhibitions, featuring speeches, refreshments, and networking opportunities. These events are a highlight of Gaborone's cultural calendar, bringing together artists, collectors, and art lovers.
events.date_range: As scheduled for each exhibition opening

events.title: Discover the Museum: Guided Group Tours
events.description: Regular guided tours for school groups, tourists, and community organisations, offered by the museum's department. Tours explore the museum's permanent and temporary exhibitions, offering insights into Botswana's cultural and natural heritage.

events.title: Botswana 360: Themed Multi-Media Exhibition
events.description: Events launching interactive and thematic exhibitions featuring historic photographs, maps, and multimedia displays on colonialism and cultural heritage. The museum has previously hosted such launches, including the baton handover for the World Athletics Relays.
